extension.summary: NewPipe MOD — Original creator: Twilight0 | MOD: @TrainAgain2
extension.description: NewPipe MOD. Original creator and upstream: Twilight0 (https://github.com/Twilight0/plugin.video.newpipe). MOD: @TrainAgain2. This is a self-contained ZIP: no external Kodi repository or script.module add-on is required. Browse and watch YouTube without an account. Search, channels, playlists and local subscriptions stay on your device. Optionally, sign in through the NewPipe MOD YouTube TV activation flow at yt.be/activate; the add-on creates a genuine YouTube TV code and QR from current public TV client data, then synchronizes account subscriptions. Playback uses the bundled native engine to obtain one direct progressive audio/video stream, without a local proxy or plugin.video.youtube.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host or distribute any content; it only browses publicly available YouTube pages. Optional account linking stores its session token only in the local Kodi add-on profile.
